name: Data Fabric
description_zh: 连接自部署的 Data Fabric，发现已授权数据源、检查表结构并执行只读查询。
description_en: Connect your Data Fabric deployment to discover authorized sources, inspect schemas, and run read-only queries.
examples_zh: 列出我有权限访问的数据源。
查看订单表的字段，并统计本月订单数量。
查询最近的订单并按需获取后续结果。
examples_en: List the data sources I can access.
Inspect the orders table and count this month’s orders.
Find recent orders and retrieve additional result pages as needed.
description: Connect your Data Fabric deployment to discover authorized sources, inspect schemas, and run read-only queries.
